description: The window a page fills, so a short page's footer sits at the bottom rather than floating halfway up. arena-shell__main goes on the one child that takes the slack. A shell with a header, a main and a footer has exactly one child that should grow, and no rule can know which. When that child is an Arena component, put a div of yours around it and the class on the div. A component's own element may carry no box, so the slack would go to nothing.
